title: Seagrove "23 Palms" 431 Eastern Lake Rd
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Fully expanded and remodeled pool deck - debuting May 1st- 6-passenger Low-speed vehicle - Minutes from the beach- Gulf and lake views- Complimentary filtered drinking water- Private saltwater pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $45 per day**- Professionally decorated- Screened porch- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Effortless beach access and breathtaking views await at 23 Palms, a quintessential Seagrove Beach retreat! Designed for multi-generational families or group getaways, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom, 2-story home comfortably sleeps 14 guests. Unwind in the private saltwater pool, enjoy the coastal breeze from multiple balconies, or head up to the lookout tower for stunning panoramic views of the coastline. Ramsgate Beach is only a short 5-minute stroll, while Eastern Lake Beach Access is only 300 feet away, offering a memorable opportunity to experience the rare dune coastal lake that makes this area unique!The first floor welcomes guests with comfort and convenience, hosting 3 bedrooms and access to the backyard. The primary bedroom features a king bed, private bathroom, and porch access, while the guest bedroom mirrors its layout with a queen bed and private bathroom. The bunk room, with 2 queen-over-queen bunks and a half-bath, is ideal for kids or adults. Spend sunny days in the fenced-in courtyard, wading in the saltwater pool, sunbathing on the loungers, or cooling off in the shade of the covered porch.Sunlight pours in through large windows, illuminating the heart of this home on the second floor, where the open-concept kitchen, living, and dining space create a cheerful sense of togetherness. The soft coastal hues and natural textures—complete with a plush couch, TV, and stunning lake views—make it the perfect spot to catch up with family. Open the doors to the attached balcony for an alfresco experience and soak in the refreshing breeze. Savor dinners homemade in the chef's kitchen, featuring sleek white cabinets and countertops, high-end appliances, a water cooler offering chilled, filtered drinking water on demand and a spacious island with a breakfast bar for 3. The dining area comfortably seats 8, making it ideal for sit-down dinners or lively family game nights. A lovely guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom completes this floor.Stairs lead up to the crow's nest, a prime locale for enjoying coffee while gazing at the tranquil Gulf waters or sipping a cocktail while taking in the romantic Florida sunset.23 Palms offers the ultimate coastal retreat, including parking for 3 vehicles, 4 complimentary bikes, and a low-speed vehicle—plus 2 paddleboards and a beach wagon for effortless trips to the beach. Both beach accesses are on Eastern Lake Road. Simply turn left when leaving the property and follow the road to the signage. Book today!This home can accommodate 3 vehicles, plus additional nearby street parking.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Half Bathroom with Toilet and Sink OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*New home construction is coming to an end on adjacent lot, with an anticipated completion between end of Spring and June 2026.*Garden shed provided with everything one would need for the beach: beach chairs, coolers, beach carts, and pool toys.
